sources.detail: All six registered pages are Cloudflare-blocked from this runner today. Direct GET with the full browser header set returned HTTP 403 with a "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" body (5,486 bytes) on every one of the six URLs; the r.jina.ai proxy was tried once as an alternate transport and returned the 403 "Just a moment..." interstitial too. This matches the pre-agent published-evidence receipt, which records http 403 and a null resolved date for all six icyveins pages. Nothing was parsed, so no letter, no snapshot and no published date moved: the registry still reads snapshot 2026-09-22 with the page-stated dates 2026-08-29/30 and 2026-09-01 exactly as committed.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 159,223 (raid) and 165,874 (M+) bytes off the decoded bodies. Parsed from the page's own `<div class="tierlist pw-item">` containers — raid 3, M+ 5 — with every entry accepted by ROSTER MATCH on its `data-original-title`, never by container position; that is what rejects the M+ page's dungeon-difficulty block, whose 8 entries (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) were the only unmatched values on either page. Per-page counts printed and reconciled BEFORE the merge: raid 40 (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), M+ 40 (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4) = 80 rows, 0 roster rows unmatched. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified from the BODY, not the metadata: both pages' `<meta name=description>` still says "The War Within Season 3" (stale boilerplate) while the visible intro says "Midnight Season 2" and names The Venomous Abyss — body over title, so seasonVerified stays s2, and Devourer is present. Each page's own "Last Updated" line was re-read live — raid 10th August 2026 -> 2026-08-10, M+ 13th August 2026 -> 2026-08-13 — matching both the committed registry and this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so `published` is unchanged and only `snapshot` advances.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 76,255-346,455 bytes. Parsed the documented way: unescape `\/` across the whole document FIRST, then take the `[tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list]` block and read `[spec-badge=<spec>-<class>]` kebab slugs with tolerant-whitespace `[tier-label]` matching — never anchored on a `WH.markup.printHtml(` call, which is the decoy that once returned 0 rows on the raid-healer page. Exactly one tier-list block per page this run. Per-page counts printed and reconciled BEFORE the merge: raid DPS 27 (A 8 / B 14 / C 5), raid Healer 7 (S 1 / A 3 / B 3), raid Tank 6 (S 1 / A 3 / B 2), M+ DPS 27 (S 1 / A+ 2 / A 7 / B 14 / C 3), M+ Healer 7 (S 1 / A 3 / B 1 / C 2), M+ Tank 6 (S 1 / A 3 / B 2) = 27+7+6 per bracket, 80 rows, 0 unmatched. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified per page: Midnight present, Season 2 the dominant season mention on all six, Devourer present on all three DPS/tank pages -> seasonVerified s2. Each page's own JSON-LD dateModified re-read live — raid DPS 2026-08-31, raid Healer 2026-08-31, raid Tank 2026-08-31, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ Healer 2026-09-10, M+ Tank 2026-09-01 — identical to the committed `published` values and to this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so only `snapshot` advances.

Merged lowerBound at the stored 1-dp precision with n = numberOfCharacters and asOf = the SOURCE's snapshotDate, never today: 0 of 40 values, dates or sample sizes moved. PARTIAL, not success, because the source's own date is 2026-09-15, nine days behind this run — the honest staleness signal is wowmeta's maxAgeDays in the contract going red, not a success claim.

Collector receipts only — no second parser was written agent-side. metrics-fetch/evidence.json (checkedAt 2026-09-24T15:30:03Z) records murlok status success: all three meta pages HTTP 200 on the first attempt (DPS 71,302 / Healer 42,311 / Tank 40,911 bytes), 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 omitted specs, dateBasis source-time-datetime. Merged metrics-fetch/updates.json through apply-metrics.mjs and re-verified with check-stable-metrics.mjs, which passed against the trusted receipts and git HEAD. PARTIAL, not success, because the page's own `<time datetime>` still reads 2026-09-17 — seven days behind this run — and that source-owned date is what was stored; a fresh 200 is not a fresh dataset.

All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 24 charts returned real payloads and 3 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on all three attempts each — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker and Devastation Evoker, the same three specs SimC has no MID2 profile for, which is upstream absence rather than a parse failure. Every returned chart carries simc_settings.ptr as the STRING "0" (compared explicitly, never truthiness) and simc_settings.tier MID2, read off the chart rather than assumed; the merged pool is 24 profiles, uniformly MID2, so the tier-uniformity and SIM_TIER_REQUIRED gates are satisfied and no MID1/MID2 mixing is possible. Targets taken best-build from data[MID2][count] at 1/2/3/5/8/15. asOf is each CHART's own timestamp, never the run date: all 24 stamp 2026-09-23. Against stored data exactly ONE profile moved — Destruction Warlock, which was the only spec still on 2026-09-16 and has now been re-simmed; its largest per-target move is 0.1%, far under maxValueMovePct. 24 rows clears the 15 floor with no row drop.

MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,439,597 bytes, and it HAD its `DPS Ranking:` block (line 60), so no HTML fallback was needed. Era-verified off the header build string, not the visible version: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-23/69933, git build HEAD c97e14c7a5, no-networking)". The git HEAD moved from the 2026-09-22 report, so this is a genuinely new sim run picking up the September 22/23 tuning, and asOf is the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-23 rather than the run date. 45 profiles plus the Raid aggregate; mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with hyphens allowed, which is what keeps MID2_Demon_Hunter_Havoc_Aldrachi_Reaver and MID2_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred attached to the right specs. Best hero-variant per DPS spec gives 24 rows; the 7 unmapped profiles are exactly the tanks (both Blood builds, both Protection Paladin builds, Protection Warrior, Brewmaster, Annihilator Vengeance) and are correctly excluded. Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker and Devastation Evoker still have no MID2 profile upstream. All 24 values moved, every one by under 1% (largest Windwalker +0.9%), consistent with a re-sim on a new build rather than a transport artifact.

The receipt's shape checks are the ones that tell the representation column from the per-key-presence widget: role totals Ranged 31.4 / Melee 28.9 / Tank 20 / Healer 20 against the page's printed 31.3 / 28.7 / 20 / 20, summing to 100.3. Three channels swept plus the official revision ledger, all reconciled. (1) LEDGER: official-notes/evidence.json (checkedAt 2026-09-24T15:30:09Z) has both configured sources at status success — live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 at version 47 (updated 2026-09-24T00:12:25.841Z) and the 12.1.5 ptr-preview topic 2344395 with posts 1/4/5. Rebuilding the pending ledger surfaced exactly TWO unresolved sections, both new and both dated 2026-09-23: Death Knight/Unholy (Blightfall bug fix) and Monk/Windwalker (PvP adjustments were applying in PvE). Both receipt texts were read with their heading nesting intact and the canonical topic JSON was independently re-fetched this run (title "World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - September 23", version 47) and cross-checked against the Wowhead mirror news=383075. Both are dispositioned applied against a new 2026-09-23 kind:hotfix feed entry; check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD passes with 0 unresolved. The ptr-preview post #5 (2026-09-22, the Glory of the Wartorn Hero achievement change) inventories ZERO class sections, so the 12.1.5 notes-only lane needed no new summaries; PHASES.ptr stays null and no 12.1.5 material entered ptr-builds, ptr verdicts, tier sets or model inputs. (2) RSS: wowhead.com/news/rss/all HTTP 200, 162,827 bytes, 40 items parsed per <item> block; the only new tuning item is news=383075 (2026-09-24T00:24:51Z) — everything else above the 09-23 watermark is WoW: Forever or Brewfest. (3) NEWS INDEX polled as well (data.news.newsData, 20 posts) and it agrees with the RSS, so nothing landed mid-run. (4) BLUE TRACKER swept (data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries / 42 unique topics): no standalone class-tuning blue post beyond the hotfix topic itself. Both new lines are bug fixes stating no tuning value, so classifyHighlight returns null for each and neither casts an outlook vote — Wowhead's derived "12% single target" figure is deliberately NOT written as an official value. No set bonus is touched anywhere in the September 23 block, so no spec.tierSet date advances. The 12.1 PTR zone lanes (WCL 52/54/56/57) stay dormant per the between-cycles posture and their contract rows were removed at the flip.

Discovery plus distillation; the agent holds no transcript credentials and made no YouTube or transcript-API request. transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict "ok", 3 of 3 requested videos fetched natively, 19 counted requests in the 30-day window. All three queued videos were distilled and drained from videos[]: YoDaTV's "ANOTHER Blood DK Nerf? Is it Over?" (2026-09-22) gave 3 M+ takes (Blood DK, Vengeance, Guardian), Shadarek's Aldrachi Reaver Havoc guide (2026-09-23) gave 2 bracket-split Havoc takes, and izen's Mythic+ Week 5 recap (2026-09-22) gave 12 M+ metaNotes. 5 prior takes and 12 prior metaNotes were superseded within the same creator+spec+lens, and no id sits in two lanes (validate passes the precedence-ladder check). RSS discovery polled ALL 44 transcribable channels (44/44 HTTP 200) against a 1,298-id seen-set union; 361 unseen videos, 66 of them keyword-matching. Four were queued for the metered drain — Obli's Unholy DK Season 2 update (kB0bop0aUpI), izen's post-tuning spec effects recap (mYt-nBOsKus), YoDaTV's Deathbringer-vs-San'layn analysis (dtQ0MnB9FxI) and Shadarek's Aldrachi Reaver's Mark bug note (UZrdIj5WLIw) — well inside PER_RUN_CAP. The rest are PoV key/raid VODs, boss guides, PvP duel content and WoW: Forever videos; they were left UNSEEN rather than marked seen, because a keyword/budget cut is not a durable dismissal. npm run audit:creators reports HIGH 0 / MED 0. No creator opinion touched a tier, and no tier-list or rank order was published in any of the three transcripts, so data/creator-predictions.json was not written.

This needs a reviewed recipe/zone-configuration check, never an agent-side inference from shared names or id patterns.
